1. Q: Authentication: Should this API require OAuth2 Bearer tokens (JWT) issued by Google Cloud Identity? If yes, please provide the scope names to use (e.g., scenarios.read, scenarios.write, approvals.write, audit.read), or confirm that we will not model scopes (single global security requirement). A: Just simple OAuth2 Bearer token
2. Q: Standard error model: Can we use a common error object { code: string, message: string, details?: array, traceId?: string } for 4xx/5xx responses, with application/json content? If different, please provide the exact fields. A: Come up with a sensible error model
3. Q: Response codes and headers: For 201 Created on POST /api/scenarios/{id}/approve, /reject, and /messages, do you want a Location header returned (e.g., pointing to the scenario or the new message resource)? If yes, specify which URL each should reference. A: no location header
4. Q: Any additional security or operational requirements to reflect (e.g., rate limiting 429, audit logging headers, correlation ID header such as X-Request-Id to echo back)? A: Nothing additional

{
  "phase": "questions",
  "section": "final_review",
  "questions": [
    "Please review and confirm this OpenAPI (yaml) for the Scenarios REST API. If it looks good, reply “confirm” and I’ll finalize.",
    "If you need any tweaks (fields, defaults, response codes), list them and I’ll update the spec."
  ],
  "summary": "openapi: 3.0.3
info:
  title: Scenarios REST API
  version: 1.0.0
  description: Public REST API for UI — scenarios, impacts, approvals, messages, and audit search.
security:
  - bearerAuth: []
paths:
  /api/scenarios:
    get:
      summary: List scenarios
      description: List scenarios visible to the current user.
      operationId: listScenarios
      parameters:
        - name: page
          in: query
          description: Page index (0-based)
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          description: Page size
          required: false
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
        - name: owner
          in: query
          description: Filter by owner identifier or display name
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: scenarioType
          in: query
          description: Filter by scenario type code
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: status
          in: query
          description: Filter by scenario status
          required: false
          schema:
            type: string
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A list of scenarios
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/Scenario'
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '500': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
  /api/scenarios/{id}:
    get:
      summary: Get scenario
      description: Retrieve a single scenario by ID.
      operationId: getScenario
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Scenario ID
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Scenario
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Scenario'
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '500': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
  /api/scenarios/{id}/impacts:
    get:
      summary: Get scenario impacts
      description: Retrieve aggregated impact summaries for a scenario.
      operationId: getScenarioImpacts
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Scenario ID
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      responses:
        '200':
          description: Impact summary
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/ImpactSummary'
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '500': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
  /api/scenarios/{id}/approve:
    post:
      summary: Approve scenario
      description: Approve a scenario with attestation.
      operationId: approveScenario
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Scenario ID
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ApprovalDecision'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Scenario approved
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Scenario'
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '500': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
  /api/scenarios/{id}/reject:
    post:
      summary: Reject scenario
      description: Reject a scenario with attestation.
      operationId: rejectScenario
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Scenario ID
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ApprovalDecision'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Scenario rejected
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Scenario'
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '500': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
  /api/scenarios/{id}/messages:
    post:
      summary: Post message
      description: Add a message/comment to a scenario thread.
      operationId: postScenarioMessage
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Scenario ID
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Message'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Message created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Message'
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '404': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '500': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
  /api/audit:
    get:
      summary: Search audit trail
      description: Search immutable audit events.
      operationId: searchAudit
      parameters:
        - name: scenarioId
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Filter by scenario ID
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
        - name: eventType
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Filter by event type
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: dateFrom
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Filter events from this timestamp (inclusive, UTC)
          schema:
            type: string
            format: date-time
        - name: dateTo
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Filter events up to this timestamp (inclusive, UTC)
          schema:
            type: string
            format: date-time
        - name: page
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Page index (0-based)
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Page size
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A list of audit events
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEvent'
        '400': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '401': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '403': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
        '500': { $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse' }
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  responses:
    ErrorResponse:
      description: Error response
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  schemas:
    Scenario:
      type: object
      description: Container linking a proposed data change (changeSet) to impacts, workflow state, and audit context.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Unique scenario identifier
        name:
          type: string
          description: Scenario name
      required: [id, name]
    ImpactSummary:
      type: object
      description: Aggregated impact metrics per calculation/domain with links to detailed reports.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Impact summary identifier
        summary:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable impact summary
      required: [id, summary]
    ApprovalDecision:
      type: object
      description: A single user decision (approve/reject) with attestation details.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Optional client-supplied identifier (ignored on processing)
        decisionMessage:
          type: string
          description: Attestation or justification for the decision
      required: [decisionMessage]
    Message:
      type: object
      description: User comments/messages supporting collaboration within a scenario thread.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          readOnly: true
          description: Message identifier (assigned by the system)
        message:
          type: string
          description: Message text
      required: [message]
    AuditEvent:
      type: object
      description: Immutable log of user/system actions (messages, approvals, promotions); retained 7 years.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Audit event identifier
        eventName:

          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
  /api/scenarios/{id}/reject:
    post:
      summary: Reject scenario
      description: Reject a scenario with attestation.
      operationId: rejectScenario
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Scenario ID
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/ApprovalDecision'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Scenario rejected
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Scenario'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
  /api/scenarios/{id}/messages:
    post:
      summary: Post message
      description: Add a message/comment to a scenario thread.
      operationId: postScenarioMessage
      parameters:
        - name: id
          in: path
          required: true
          description: Scenario ID
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
      requestBody:
        required: true
        content:
          application/json:
            schema:
              $ref: '#/components/schemas/Message'
      responses:
        '201':
          description: Message created
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                $ref: '#/components/schemas/Message'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
        '404':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
  /api/audit:
    get:
      summary: Search audit trail
      description: Search immutable audit events.
      operationId: searchAudit
      parameters:
        - name: scenarioId
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Filter by scenario ID
          schema:
            type: string
            format: uuid
        - name: eventType
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Filter by event type
          schema:
            type: string
        - name: dateFrom
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Filter events from this timestamp (inclusive, UTC)
          schema:
            type: string
            format: date-time
        - name: dateTo
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Filter events up to this timestamp (inclusive, UTC)
          schema:
            type: string
            format: date-time
        - name: page
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Page index (0-based)
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 0
            default: 0
        - name: size
          in: query
          required: false
          description: Page size
          schema:
            type: integer
            minimum: 1
            maximum: 100
            default: 20
      responses:
        '200':
          description: A list of audit events
          content:
            application/json:
              schema:
                type: array
                items:
                  $ref: '#/components/schemas/AuditEvent'
        '400':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
        '401':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
        '403':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
        '500':
          $ref: '#/components/responses/ErrorResponse'
components:
  securitySchemes:
    bearerAuth:
      type: http
      scheme: bearer
      bearerFormat: JWT
  responses:
    ErrorResponse:
      description: Error response
      content:
        application/json:
          schema:
            $ref: '#/components/schemas/Error'
  schemas:
    Scenario:
      type: object
      description: Container linking a proposed data change (changeSet) to impacts, workflow state, and audit context.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Unique scenario identifier
        name:
          type: string
          description: Scenario name
      required:
        - id
        - name
    ImpactSummary:
      type: object
      description: Aggregated impact metrics per calculation/domain with links to detailed reports.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Impact summary identifier
        summary:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable impact summary
      required:
        - id
        - summary
    ApprovalDecision:
      type: object
      description: A single user decision (approve/reject) with attestation details.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Optional client-supplied identifier (ignored on processing)
        decisionMessage:
          type: string
          description: Attestation or justification for the decision
      required:
        - decisionMessage
    Message:
      type: object
      description: User comments/messages supporting collaboration within a scenario thread.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          readOnly: true
          description: Message identifier (assigned by the system)
        message:
          type: string
          description: Message text
      required:
        - message
    AuditEvent:
      type: object
      description: Immutable log of user/system actions (messages, approvals, promotions); retained 7 years.
      properties:
        id:
          type: string
          format: uuid
          description: Audit event identifier
        eventName:
          type: string
          description: Event type/name
      required:
        - id
        - eventName
    Error:
      type: object
      description: Standard error payload.
      properties:
        code:
          type: string
          description: Machine-readable error code
        message:
          type: string
          description: Human-readable error message
        details:
          type: array
          description: Optional list of error details (e.g., field-level)
          items:
            type: object
            properties:
              field:
                type: string
              message:
                type: string
              code:
                type: string
            additionalProperties: false
        traceId:
          type: string
          description: Correlation identifier for troubleshooting
      required:
        - code
        - message
